inventory.detail.title: 库存与目标明细分页
inventory.detail.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。

gea_p18.format: LIKE pattern; host escapes literal %/_/backslash and surrounds with % for literal contains

MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.pinxiang) = 1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(t.pinxiang, '')) = COUNT(*) THEN MAX(t.pinxiang) ELSE NULL END AS item, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.material_group_name) = 1 AND COUNT(NULLIF(t.material_group_name, '')) = COUNT(*) THEN MAX(t.material_group_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_group FROM agents_order_execute_isontime_mi material_dictionary AS (SELECT u.sku AS sku, COALESCE(MAX(u.order_category), MAX(u.movement_category)) AS category, MAX(u.item) AS item, COALESCE(MAX(u.order_group), MAX(u.movement_group)) AS material_group FROM (SELECT o.sku AS sku, o.category AS order_category, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS movement_category, o.item AS item, o.material_group AS order_group, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS movement_group FROM order_material_dictionary AS o UNION ALL SELECT m.sku AS sku, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS order_category, m.category AS movement_category, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS item, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS order_group, m.material_group AS movement_group FROM movement_material_dictionary AS m) AS u GROUP BY u.sku), target_source AS (SELECT t.year_month AS year_month, t.inventory_version AS inventory_version, t.belong_base AS belong_base, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_categ_name) ELSE NULL END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_tag) ELSE NULL END AS product_tag, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_inventory) ELSE NULL END AS current_inventory, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.turnover_inventory) ELSE NULL END AS turnover_inventory, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.safety_stock) ELSE NULL END AS safety_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.avg_daily_planned_demand) ELSE NULL END AS avg_daily_planned_demand, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.target_inventory) ELSE NULL END AS target_inventory, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.management_target_inventory) ELSE NULL END AS management_target_inventory, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.final_target_inventory) ELSE NULL END AS final_target_inventory, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_turnover_days) ELSE NULL END AS current_turnover_days, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.target_fill_rate) ELSE NULL END AS target_fill_rate, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.avg_30d_sale) ELSE NULL END AS avg_30d_sale, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM agents_scm_goods_inventory_turnover_data_m AS t WHERE t.year_month = :gea_p1 AND (t.inventory_version = :gea_p2 OR (:gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND t.inventory_version = '月初')) GROUP BY t.year_month, t.inventory_version, t.belong_base, t.material_code), stock_source AS (SELECT t.data_month AS data_month, t.the_date AS the_date, t.belong_base AS belong_base, t.material_code AS material_code, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.material_name) ELSE NULL END AS material_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.product_item) ELSE NULL END AS product_item, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.series) ELSE NULL END AS series, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.spec) ELSE NULL END AS spec, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.channel_name) ELSE NULL END AS channel_name, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_stock) ELSE NULL END AS current_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.available_stock) ELSE NULL END AS available_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.current_stock_60) ELSE NULL END AS current_stock_60, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.allocated_qty) ELSE NULL END AS allocated_qty, MAX(t.avg_30d_send) ELSE NULL END AS avg_30d_send, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.avg_30d_sale) ELSE NULL END AS avg_30d_sale, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.begin_stock) ELSE NULL END AS begin_stock, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.month_plan_qty) ELSE NULL END AS month_plan_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.month_order_qty) ELSE NULL END AS month_order_qty, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.next_month_out_plan) ELSE NULL END AS next_month_out_plan, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN MAX(t.next_month_sales_plan) ELSE NULL END AS next_month_sales_plan, COUNT(*) AS source_rows FROM agents_scm_stock_detail_d AS t WHERE t.data_month = CAST(:gea_p1 AS DATE) AND t.the_date = :gea_p3 GROUP BY t.data_month, t.the_date, t.belong_base, t.material_code), target_keys AS (SELECT t.belong_base AS base, t.material_code AS sku FROM target_source AS t GROUP BY t.belong_base, t.material_code), targets AS (SELECT k.base AS base, k.sku AS sku, CASE WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.inventory_version ELSE c.inventory_version END AS effective_version, CASE WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.material_name ELSE c.material_name END AS material_name, CASE WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.product_categ_name ELSE c.product_categ_name END AS product_categ_name, CASE WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.product_tag ELSE c.product_tag END AS product_tag, CASE WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.current_inventory ELSE c.current_inventory END AS current_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.turnover_inventory IS NULL OR c.turnover_inventory <= 0))) AND m.turnover_inventory > 0 THEN m.turnover_inventory WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.turnover_inventory ELSE c.turnover_inventory END AS turnover_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.safety_stock IS NULL OR c.safety_stock <= 0))) AND m.safety_stock > 0 THEN m.safety_stock WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.safety_stock ELSE c.safety_stock END AS safety_stock, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.avg_daily_planned_demand IS NULL OR c.avg_daily_planned_demand <= 0))) AND m.avg_daily_planned_demand > 0 THEN m.avg_daily_planned_demand WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.avg_daily_planned_demand ELSE c.avg_daily_planned_demand END AS avg_daily_planned_demand, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.target_inventory IS NULL OR c.target_inventory <= 0))) AND m.target_inventory > 0 THEN m.target_inventory WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.target_inventory ELSE c.target_inventory END AS target_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.management_target_inventory IS NULL OR c.management_target_inventory <= 0))) AND m.management_target_inventory > 0 THEN m.management_target_inventory WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.management_target_inventory ELSE c.management_target_inventory END AS management_target_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.final_target_inventory IS NULL OR c.final_target_inventory <= 0))) AND m.final_target_inventory > 0 THEN m.final_target_inventory WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.final_target_inventory ELSE c.final_target_inventory END AS final_target_inventory, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.current_turnover_days IS NULL OR c.current_turnover_days <= 0))) AND m.current_turnover_days > 0 THEN m.current_turnover_days WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.current_turnover_days ELSE c.current_turnover_days END AS current_turnover_days, CASE WHEN :gea_p2 = '纠偏' AND (c.material_code IS NULL OR (c.source_rows = 1 AND (c.target_fill_rate IS NULL OR c.target_fill_rate <= 0))) AND m.target_fill_rate > 0 THEN m.target_fill_rate WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.target_fill_rate ELSE c.target_fill_rate END AS target_fill_rate, CASE WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.avg_30d_sale ELSE c.avg_30d_sale END AS avg_30d_sale, CASE WHEN c.material_code IS NULL THEN m.source_rows ELSE c.source_rows END AS target_rows FROM target_keys AS k LEFT JOIN target_source AS c ON c.belong_base = k.base AND c.material_code = k.sku AND c.inventory_version = :gea_p2 LEFT JOIN target_source AS m ON m.belong_base = k.base AND m.material_code = k.sku AND m.inventory_version = '月初' AND :gea_p2 = '纠偏'), inventory_keys AS (SELECT t.base AS base, t.sku AS sku FROM targets AS t UNION ALL SELECT s.belong_base AS base, s.material_code AS sku FROM stock_source AS s LEFT JOIN targets AS t ON t.base = s.belong_base AND t.sku = s.material_code WHERE t.sku IS NULL), aligned AS (SELECT k.base AS base, k.sku AS sku, :gea_p1 AS month, :gea_p3 AS stock_date, t.effective_version AS effective_version, COALESCE(s.material_name, t.material_name) AS material_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.product_categ_name, ''), d.category) AS category, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.product_item, ''), d.item) AS item, s.series AS series, s.channel_name AS channel, t.product_tag AS product_tag, s.current_stock AS inventory, s.available_stock AS available, s.current_stock_60 AS over60, t.avg_daily_planned_demand AS daily_demand, t.safety_stock AS safety_stock, t.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, t.target_inventory AS initial_target, t.management_target_inventory AS management_target, t.final_target_inventory AS final_target, CASE WHEN t.sku IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.product_categ_name = '粽子' OR t.product_tag LIKE '%粽子%' OR t.material_name LIKE '%粽子%' THEN CASE WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN t.avg_daily_planned_demand > 0 THEN t.turnover_inventory ELSE 0 END ELSE t.final_target_inventory END AS target, t.avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, s.avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, s.allocated_qty AS allocated, s.ordered_qty AS ordered, COALESCE(t.target_rows, 0) AS target_source_rows, COALESCE(s.source_rows, 0) AS stock_source_rows FROM inventory_keys AS k LEFT JOIN targets AS t ON t.base = k.base AND t.sku = k.sku LEFT JOIN stock_source AS s ON s.belong_base = k.base AND s.material_code = k.sku LEFT JOIN material_dictionary AS d ON d.sku = k.sku), business_rows AS (SELECT a.base AS base, a.sku AS sku, a.month AS month, a.stock_date AS stock_date, a.effective_version AS effective_version, a.material_name AS material_name, a.category AS category, a.item AS item, a.series AS series, a.channel AS channel, a.product_tag AS product_tag, a.inventory AS inventory, a.available AS available, a.over60 AS over60, a.daily_demand AS daily_demand, a.safety_stock AS safety_stock, a.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, a.initial_target AS initial_target, a.management_target AS management_target, a.final_target AS final_target, a.target AS target, a.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, a.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, a.allocated AS allocated, a.ordered AS ordered, a.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, a.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, a.inventory - a.target AS gap, CASE WHEN a.inventory IS NULL OR a.target IS NULL THEN 'unknown' WHEN a.inventory < a.target THEN 'low' WHEN a.inventory > a.target THEN 'high' ELSE 'normal' END AS risk FROM aligned AS a), filtered AS (SELECT r.base AS base, r.sku AS sku, r.month AS month, r.stock_date AS stock_date, r.effective_version AS effective_version, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.item AS item, r.series AS series, r.channel AS channel, r.product_tag AS product_tag, r.inventory AS inventory, r.available AS available, r.over60 AS over60, r.daily_demand AS daily_demand, r.safety_stock AS safety_stock, r.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, r.initial_target AS initial_target, r.management_target AS management_target, r.final_target AS final_target, r.target AS target, r.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, r.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, r.allocated AS allocated, r.ordered AS ordered, r.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, r.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, r.gap AS gap, r.risk AS risk FROM business_rows AS r WHERE (:gea_p4 = FALSE OR r.base IN (:gea_p5)) AND (:gea_p6 = 'all' OR (:gea_p6 = 'equal' AND r.sku = :gea_p7) OR (:gea_p6 = 'missing' AND r.sku IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p8 = 'all' OR (:gea_p8 = 'equal' AND r.category = :gea_p9) OR (:gea_p8 = 'missing' AND r.category IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p10 = 'all' OR (:gea_p10 = 'equal' AND r.item = :gea_p11) OR (:gea_p10 = 'missing' AND r.item IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p12 = 'all' OR (:gea_p12 = 'equal' AND r.series = :gea_p13) OR (:gea_p12 = 'missing' AND r.series IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p14 = 'all' OR (:gea_p14 = 'equal' AND r.channel = :gea_p15) OR (:gea_p14 = 'missing' AND r.channel IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p16 = 'all' OR (:gea_p16 = 'equal' AND r.risk = :gea_p17) OR (:gea_p16 = 'missing' AND r.risk IS NULL)) AND (:gea_p18 IS NULL OR LOWER(r.sku) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18) OR LOWER(r.material_name) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18) OR LOWER(r.category) LIKE LOWER(:gea_p18)) AND (:gea_p19 IS NULL OR r.category IS NULL OR r.category <> :gea_p19)) SELECT r.base AS base, r.sku AS sku, r.month AS month, r.stock_date AS stock_date, r.effective_version AS effective_version, r.material_name AS material_name, r.category AS category, r.item AS item, r.series AS series, r.channel AS channel, r.product_tag AS product_tag, r.inventory AS inventory, r.available AS available, r.over60 AS over60, r.daily_demand AS daily_demand, r.safety_stock AS safety_stock, r.turnover_inventory AS turnover_inventory, r.initial_target AS initial_target, r.management_target AS management_target, r.final_target AS final_target, r.target AS target, r.target_avg_30d_sale AS target_avg_30d_sale, r.stock_avg_30d_sale AS stock_avg_30d_sale, r.allocated AS allocated, r.ordered AS ordered, r.target_source_rows AS target_source_rows, r.stock_source_rows AS stock_source_rows, r.gap AS gap, r.risk AS risk FROM filtered AS r ORDER BY CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND r.gap IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.gap ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'gap' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.gap ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND r.inventory IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.inventory ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.inventory ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND r.target IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.target ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'target' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.target ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND r.safety_stock IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.safety_stock ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'safety_stock' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.safety_stock ELSE NULL END DESC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND r.turnover_inventory IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'asc' THEN r.turnover_inventory ELSE NULL END ASC, CASE WHEN :gea_p22 = 'turnover_inventory' AND :gea_p23 = 'desc' THEN r.turnover_inventory ELSE NULL END DESC, r.base ASC, r.sku ASC LIMIT :gea_p20 OFFSET :gea_p21

inventory.summary.notes: 日实存与目标键并集；库存缺行保持NULL，目标重复不任选；仅纠偏允许正值月初回补；滚动不回补。SKU编码精确连接，不自动去前导零。stock_date须属于month。源品类仅来自目标，不把品项当品类。目标粽子规则保留，缺日均需求不补0。目标月份不是目标采集时间。 known_*为已知值口径，须随missing_*显示部分；动销仍为源日均，不能赋给shipment30。 汇总不受列表分页参数影响。

/* branch:base-stock-batches */
    SELECT i.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, CAST(i.prod_date AS TEXT) AS production_date,

      CASE WHEN COUNT(i.available_qty)=COUNT(*) THEN SUM(i.available_qty) END AS available_qty,

    FROM agents_scm_base_stock_batch AS i
    WHERE i.snapshot_date=CAST($1 AS DATE) AND i.material_code=$2 AND i.base_name=$3 AND i.snapshot_time=CAST($4 AS TIMESTAMPTZ)
    GROUP BY i.snapshot_date, i.warehouse_name, i.prod_date
    HAVING SUM(i.live_qty) <> 0 OR SUM(i.available_qty) <> 0 OR COUNT(i.available_qty)<>COUNT(*) OR COUNT(i.live_qty)<>COUNT(*)

/* warehouse_catalog:plans */

        SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 AND snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date >= 60 AND snapshot_date::date - prod_date::date < 90 THEN live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS age_60_90_qty,
        SUM(CASE WHEN live_qty > 0 AND prod_date IS NULL THEN live_qty ELSE 0 END) AS unknown_age_qty,
